scope: Read-only methodology review; independent toy oracle only; no repository/GitHub mutation, model execution, package installation, or hardware execution.

primary_sources.title: AMD UG573: Block RAM and UltraRAM Differences
primary_sources.evidence: Official search result exposes section text; parent UG573 page opened. Per-port read-or-write operation and non-equivalence to ordinary SDP/TDP mode labels.
primary_sources.boundary: Used to motivate explicit abstract port semantics, not to assert the target project uses UltraRAM.

primary_sources.title: Intel oneAPI FPGA Handbook: Memory Attributes
primary_sources.evidence: Official page opened; bank_bits uses word addressing; bankwidth, replication and doublepump explicitly distinguish resources.
primary_sources.boundary: No FPGA frequency/resource figure transferred into the abstract accelerator.

primary_sources.title: AMD XD099: Deadlock Detection and Analysis
primary_sources.evidence: Official indexed section shows FIFO capacity and production/consumption order affect deadlock.
primary_sources.boundary: Independent toy consumer uses atomic A+B, so its exact depth threshold is not attributed to the vendor example.

primary_sources.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
primary_sources.evidence: Official arXiv abstract and version history opened.
primary_sources.boundary: Algorithmic IO-awareness motivates separating schedule from topology; no GPU speedup or IO bound transplanted as hardware proof.

primary_sources.title: Lee and Messerschmitt: Synchronous Data Flow
primary_sources.evidence: Authors' Berkeley publication page opened; fixed production/consumption rates and static scheduling.
primary_sources.boundary: Dataflow formulation is established method, not claimed novelty.
